description: Source code implementing WebSocket transport functions for MQTT client, including connect, write, read, and disconnect operations.

methods.name: mqtt_client_websocket_connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for MQTT client, handling secure and non-secure transports.

methods.name: mqtt_client_websocket_write
methods.description: Sends binary data over WebSocket connection.

methods.name: mqtt_client_websocket_write_msg
methods.description: Sends a message composed of multiple buffers over WebSocket.

methods.name: mqtt_client_websocket_read
methods.description: Reads data from WebSocket connection, handling message types and connection status.

methods.name: mqtt_client_websocket_disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and underlying transport.
